name: cpcp_demo
description: Executable PushNote/PullNote demo: stub seam plus push/pull clients in eight languages.

contract.note: CIDs and clients implement the contract at this revision; drift is the runner's job to catch, not this file's. Full SHA per repo-format rule 5; this read 3b9ce9b, which is not an object a reader can verify and stops being unique as the repo grows.

registry.note: The registry revision this demo is read against. cpcps is empty at this SHA, so the demo is not yet listed in it -- recorded rather than left to look like an oversight. Full SHA, never an abbreviation.

scopes.note: One manifest per scope, including the two this repo does not serve: an omitted scope cannot be told apart from an overlooked one (repo-format rule 2).

cids_note: Rule 7 asks for ONE caller per CID. This repo is the demonstration, so it carries one per language -- that is a choice, not the bar.
